simplicity.residual_blocking_10: apps/web/src/pages/TierBoardPage.tsx:1-443 — 443 LOC modal orchestration floor; deletion test fails for any extraction without co-moving modal state

test_strategy.proof: apps/web/src/pages/ThemesPage.test.tsx — 3 tests: Themes heading, one card per BUNDLED_THEMES, theme display names. apps/web/src/pages/TemplatesPage.test.tsx — 4 tests: Template Library heading, search field + category picker present, search state machine (searchQuery setState → Search Results heading), default all-templates + featured templates state. apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.test.tsx — 5 tests: Import/Export heading, empty state 'Add some items' message, export format cards with items present, showResetConfirm opens on Reset click, showResetConfirm closes on Cancel click. 34 suites, 227 tests, all green (up from 31/215). G24: all 6 web pages now have direct page-level test files covering mutation paths. G26: 3 new test files in this loop's diff prove structural change. Accepted residual: AppShell routing (thin wrapper; no AppRuntime/root-scene shell in React/Vite stack; E2E surface covers integration paths).
test_strategy.residual_blocking_10: AppShell routing thin wrapper — no AppRuntime/root-scene shell analog in React/Vite; E2E surface covers integration; direct AppShell test would be ceremony over a 3-route switch
test_strategy.residual_rationale_or_backlog_ref: React/Vite stack does not have the Apple AppRuntime/root-scene shell pattern. AppShell is a thin react-router-dom BrowserRouter + 6 routes. Direct test would require mocking all 6 pages and would test routing config, not Interface behavior. E2E suite covers integration paths. Accepted carve-out.

builder_notes.pattern: CardView children is a render-prop (factory function), not a static node
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: <CardView items={...}>{(item) => ...}</CardView> — children receives each item and returns a node. A plain children pass-through stub silently renders nothing.
builder_notes.stack_example: ThemesPage.test.tsx and TemplatesPage.test.tsx CardView stub: props.items.map((item) => props.children(item))

builder_notes.pattern: S2 SearchField and Picker use value/onChange patterns with string (not event) callbacks
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: onChange={(value) => setSearchQuery(value)} — callback receives string value, not a DOM event
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Stub SearchField as native input: onChange: (e) => props.onChange?.(e.target.value). Stub Picker as native select: onChange: (e) => props.onSelectionChange?.(e.target.value).
builder_notes.stack_example: TemplatesPage.test.tsx SearchField stub maps DOM event to S2's string-based onChange

builder_notes.pattern: DialogTrigger isOpen-aware stub required for AlertDialog open/close assertions
builder_notes.how_to_recognize: DialogTrigger with isOpen={showResetConfirm} — simple children pass-through always renders AlertDialog, causing 'dialog initially absent' assertions to fail
builder_notes.smallest_coding_rule: Stub DialogTrigger: props.isOpen ? render all children : render only children[0] (the trigger). Same pattern reused across HeadToHeadPage, ImportExportPage, TemplatesPage tests.
builder_notes.stack_example: ImportExportPage.test.tsx: const childArray = React.Children.toArray(props.children); return props.isOpen ? childArray : childArray.slice(0, 1)

narrative: Good app, place but not win. Loop 26: test_strategy 9.0→9.5 via page-level tests for ThemesPage (3 tests), TemplatesPage (4 tests: filter + search state machine), and ImportExportPage (5 tests: empty state + showResetConfirm open/close). 34 suites, 227 tests, all green. All 6 web pages now have direct page-level test files — test_strategy residual accepted (AppShell thin routing wrapper, no AppRuntime analog, E2E covers integration). Remaining hard blockers: implicit global store (state_management 6.5), within-app DAG convention-only (data_flow 6.5). Loop 27 is the final cap loop; no structural fix for the 6.5 dimensions is available under the rubric without process-lifetime ownership changes.

loop_result.what_changed: Added apps/web/src/pages/ThemesPage.test.tsx (3 tests: heading, theme cards, display names), apps/web/src/pages/TemplatesPage.test.tsx (4 tests: heading, filter controls, search state machine, default state), and apps/web/src/pages/ImportExportPage.test.tsx (5 tests: heading, empty state, export cards, showResetConfirm open/close). Tests use @testing-library/react + real RTK store + minimal mocks for @react-spectrum/s2, react-router-dom, and import/export hooks.
loop_result.evidence_change_is_honest: 34 suites, 227 tests (up from 31/215), all green. New tests are deterministic: fireEvent.change drives useState filter transitions; fireEvent.click drives showResetConfirm open/close; no sleeps; assertions on text content, testid presence/absence, and DOM query.

implementation_review.reason: All three checks passed: page-level test surface added at ThemesPage, TemplatesPage, and ImportExportPage Interfaces; tests exercise real state machines (showResetConfirm useState, searchQuery/selectedCategory filter transitions, theme card rendering); no regressions introduced — purely additive test files with no production source changes.
